newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria sees strong earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria sees strong earnings growth.

text.p: Bank Austria said on Monday it expected good earnings growth for the full-year but cautioned against multiplying its six-month results by two.
"For 1997 Bank Austria expects a very satisfactory earnings development. But one should not extrapolate full-year figures from the good half-year result," the bank said in a statement.
The bank said a favourable economic environment should lead to lower provisions for bad debt and forecast its acquisition benefits.
Bank Austria's group operating profit rose 25 percent to 7.12 billion schillings in the first half of the year. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
